scripts.build: pnpm -C typescript build && pnpm -C desktop build && pnpm -C python build
scripts.check:lint: vp fmt --check && vp lint && pnpm -C python check:lint
scripts.check:types: tsgo --noEmit && pnpm -C standard check:types && pnpm -C typescript check:types && pnpm -C desktop check:types && pnpm -C python check:types
scripts.prepare: lefthook install && mkdir -p .claude && ln -sfn ../.agents/skills .claude/skills && (command -v uv >/dev/null && pnpm -C python setup || true)
scripts.test: pnpm check:lint && vp test && pnpm -C standard test && pnpm -C typescript test && pnpm -C desktop test && pnpm -C python test
scripts.test:unit: vp test && pnpm -C standard test:unit && pnpm -C typescript test:unit && pnpm -C desktop test:unit && pnpm -C python test:unit
